description: K₃Na(MoO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.60-3.19 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.80-3.15 Å. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MoO₄ tetrahedra. There are four shorter (2.43 Å) and two longer (2.49 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Mo is bonded to four O atoms to form MoO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-39°. There are a spread of Mo-O bond distances ranging from 1.79-1.81 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two K and one Mo atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Mo atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three K, one Na, and one Mo atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four K, one Na, and one Mo atom.
